newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures fall on supply concerns.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures fall on supply concerns.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures settled lower due to long-liquidation on Friday, as an increase in Japanese rubber stocks announced late on Thursday fuelled concerns over near-term oversupply trends, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.7 yen to 2.2 yen per kg lower. Benchmark February was 2.2 yen weaker at 139.7 yen.
A weaker Thai rubber offer price to Japan was also viewed as bearish for the market. Activity was buoyant.
There was some bargain-hunting buying and fresh buying in distant months. "Nearby months have more room to fall amid near-term supply concerns," one trader said.
